independent_process_state_note: Dryad official file descriptions define BF=bee-fly, B=honeybee/carpenter bee, L=lepidoptera; 2014 temporal sheet labels Bf=Bee Fly and B=Butterfly, so codes are source-provenance inconsistent. Visit predictor is original LA001 case-normalized AH+BF proxy, not validated pollen compatibility.

fixed_key_contract.maternal_source_marker: Trailing ! in MLTR first-column maternal row; mother block is consecutive following offspring rows until next !
fixed_key_contract.maternal_label_2014: Remove verified site prefix before final '_' (W_, Q_, 24_, L_); keep family-individual suffix
fixed_key_contract.maternal_label_2015: Remove the trailing maternal M marker if present; some have no M; never fuzzy match plant labels.
fixed_key_contract.offspring_label: Must match normalized *preceding* maternal string within same site/year; 7 rows with mismatching source labels are excluded before allele comparisons, not repaired by guessing a mother.
fixed_key_contract.duplicates: Exclude *both* mother blocks for the one exact duplicate 2014 site 3 field identifier and all their offspring; no maternal key has two independent contributions.
fixed_key_contract.unmatched: Exclude original genotype-source mothers not matched to an existing field site/year ID; no imputed site, year or genotype.
fixed_key_contract.genotype_phenotype_check: Maternal SC/SI source class must match field binary SC/SI marker; stop on any mismatch
fixed_key_contract.loci: Six source microsatellite loci have paired alleles in numeric zero-indexed columns (2,3), (4,5), ..., (12,13). Treat a locus as typed only if both alleles of maternal and offspring are finite, positive integers. 0, blank and invalid tokens are missing, never a new allele.
fixed_key_contract.exposure: Use the original LA001 source decoding of flower-hours and AH/BF case-normalized visits to the same 245 field mother keys; exclude 38 zero-open flower positions, one out-of-range position and 4 incomplete sessions. Do not silently replace 6,663 decoded positions with published 3,748.
fixed_key_contract.rate: log1p((AH+BF visits)/recorded flower-hours). BF casefold is an explicitly limited source proxy; not genetically compatible pollen.

outcome.name: offspring_confirmed_nonmaternal_allele_fraction
outcome.definition: Offspring is confirmed as carrying a nonmaternal allele if at least one of its typed loci has an allele not equal to either of the two typed maternal alleles at that locus. Use at least 4 jointly typed loci. Aggregate k/n per mother, n being eligible typed offspring.
outcome.scope: A conservative detectable-outcrossing indicator; outcrossed progeny sharing maternal allele sizes can be undetected, and genotyping errors can mimic nonmaternal alleles. Not exact outcrossing rate, paternity or compatible pollen.
outcome.no_redefinition: No after-outcome switch to mean relatedness, full MLTR outcross, offspring heterozygosity, 6-locus requirement, source marker, germination or seed count.

prediction.evaluation_unit: One unique maternal field plant with >=4 eligible offspring; four sites held out across both years, not one offspring per independent sample
prediction.model_M0: intercept + 2015 + SC + year×SC + log1p(lifetime flowers) + day-to-flower/30 + maternal fraction heterozygous typed loci
prediction.model_M1: M0 + log1p(AH+BF visits per open-flower hour)
prediction.fit: For each training mother calculate empirical logit log((k+0.5)/(n-k+0.5)), fit an unweighted ridge linear regression (lambda 1) on training-fold standardized non-intercept features, predict held-out logit and inverse-logit to [0,1].
prediction.primary_score: Mother-average squared error between held-out predicted lower-bound proportion and empirical offspring k/n: mean((p_hat - k/n)^2) with each mother contributing one independent observational unit
prediction.secondary_score: Per-mother absolute error and grouped SI/SC by site/year (descriptive; no new p-values).
prediction.success_gate: Strictly positive pooled M0-M1 Brier improvement and positive improvement in >=3/4 site-heldout folds. This is within-study feasibility only, not a novel general law.
prediction.failure_gate: NO_ROBUST_MATING_PROXY_SITE_TRANSFER_INCREMENT if criterion not met. No re-tuning/outlier removal/alternate loci after opening child alleles.
prediction.abstain: If source gate yields fewer than 10 maternal units in any held-out site, any source code or actual visit mapping violates frozen keys, or fewer than 100 total mothers with >=4 eligible offspring, report COVERAGE_STOP, never relax criteria.

originality_boundaries: 2017 paper already analyzed mating system and outcrossing for these arrays using MLTR; this is not original discovery of self-compatibility, outcrossing or seed discounting
The new source individual-level lower bound is not MLTR multilocus estimated outcrossing rate
One original 4-site study cannot validate island/urban convergence
Site-varying genetic structure, mother genotype and effective pollination confound comparisons
No field-gene-flow intervention or confirmed causal pollen-recipient function
Do not replace frozen LA001/LA002 negative seed-prediction outcomes
reporting: Source-only key/offspring typed-loci counts by year×site, no individual IDs
Child genotyping completeness and true admitted mother denominator
Four site-fold M0/M1 Brier, pooled Brier, success/failure label, SC/SI descriptives only
No row-level source observations or allele calls committed to GitHub
Original source archive SHA, protocol-only commit ancestor, reproducibility safeguards
